name: assay
description: Blind trial bench for model selection. Runs one workload across every model on the bench in parallel with the names shuffled to letters, scores the anonymised outputs with a blind examiner, measures token cost and latency, then reveals which model earned which column and folds the crown into a personal routing policy.
_comment: Swap tool_id for the id you mint at https://anna.partners/executa, then run: node ../scripts/set-tool-id.mjs apply --tool <minted-id>. distribution.type binary is what the Marketplace installs; active_profile local is what anna-app dev uses. `command` is honoured by anna-app dev auto-discovery and is intentionally absent here because the CLI reads entry for the node type.
